targets.title: Organization of the nervous system
targets.description: 8.a Describe the anatomical organization and general functions of the nervous system, including major cell types, brain regions, the spinal cord, and peripheral nerves.

targets.title: Sensory and motor pathways
targets.description: 8.b Explain how the nervous system processes and integrates sensory and motor information, including sensory pathways, motor pathways, and cortical functional areas.

targets.title: Somatic, autonomic, and cranial nerves
targets.description: 8.c Compare the somatic and autonomic divisions of the nervous system, including the structures and functions of the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems and cranial nerves.

targets.title: Neurons, synapses, and reflexes
targets.description: 8.d Describe neural communication and response mechanisms, including neuron function, synaptic activity, and the process of neural reflexes.

targets.title: Special senses
targets.description: 8.e Explain the structures and physiological processes involved in the major special senses, including olfaction, gustation, hearing, equilibrium, and vision.
